title: lint: the field-name indexes outside indexObjectGraph (validate-expressions, indexObjectFields readers, hook-body-writes, sortable-fields, translation-references) still read declared objects only, refusing extension-added fields
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ③ carried from PR #30432 (#30383), whose census went wider than the card; filed so that PR stays at the fourteen rules the card named. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2, the same family and the same author (HotCRM, hotcrm#2315: a module package adds fields to an app package's object through `objectExtensions`) as #30303 and #30383, now through formulas, validations, flows, hooks, page props and action bodies. Route: `domain:spec` (packages/lint).

**What an author sees.** The runtime serves an object with every body's `objectExtensions` folded in. After #30383, the fourteen `indexObjectGraph` rules read that served shape through `objectsAsServed` (`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`). These field-name indexes still read declared objects only, so a `record.FIELD` read or a write that names an extension-added field reads as unknown (census at PR #30432's head `806dd06b`, by reading, not reproduced per site):

- `validate-expressions.ts` `buildFieldIndex` (the `record.FIELD` reads of validations, formulas, flows, hooks and sharing-rule conditions; ≈:202, :2231);
- `indexObjectFields` in `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` (≈:458-461), called by `validate-react-page-props.ts` (≈:1139), `validate-flow-node-writes.ts` (≈:240) and `validate-action-body-writes.ts` (≈:382);
- the own copy in `validate-hook-body-writes.ts` (≈:505, :1106);
- `validate-sortable-fields.ts` (`recordsOf(stack.objects)`, ≈:508 at open PR #30270's head; that file lands with #30093).

Two more readers fold extensions their own way:
- `validate-translation-references.ts` keeps a third private `objectExtensionsByTarget` (≈:1135-1152: top level plus every body, every entry kept). It also folds validation rules, which the shared fold does not carry, so #30383 did not move it.
- `defineStack`'s `collectRelatedListNameErrors` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` ≈:4063-4100) folds every entry additively; lint is now the stricter of the two on the replaced-entry case.

## Wanted

- [ ] Move each index above onto the shared fold (`objectsAsServed`, or a field-index helper beside it), one fold for all. For each, say whether an extension-added field should satisfy it; a write rule may need the field's owner too.
- [ ] Decide for `validate-translation-references.ts` whether the shared fold should carry validation rules or the reader keeps its own fold with the registry's one-entry-per-package rule; say why.
- [ ] Align `collectRelatedListNameErrors` with the registry's one-entry-per-package replacement, or say why `defineStack` stays additive.
- [ ] A pin per moved site: an extension-added field passes; a field no body declares or extends is still refused with the same rule id.
- [ ] `validate-sortable-fields.ts` only after #30093's PR #30270 lands; ⛔ no edits on that branch.

Blocked-by: #30383
